title: Strategies for missing values: drop, fill, impute or flag

videos.script: Lesson 3 asked why each value is missing. This one decides what to do about it, and there are only four moves. {{four}} Drop the row. Fill it with a constant. Impute it from the values you have. Or keep the blank and say so with a flag. {{moves}} Every one of them changes a number somebody will read. Dropping the customers with no birth year removes more than three quarters of the shops' customers. {{drop}} Filling delivery times with the average leaves the average where it was, and quietly shrinks the spread. {{centre}} Carrying yesterday's sales into a closed day invents money. {{forward}} And the humblest move, a flag that says the timer gave up, is the one that gets the late deliveries exactly right. {{flag}} No move is safe in general. Each is right for one kind of blank and wrong for another. This lesson shows each one on the same data, and measures what it costs. {{end}}
